correctness.rationale: For support exceeding N, a degree-(N-1) polynomial cannot vanish at the entire support, making the Toeplitz moment Gram matrix G strictly positive; the cosine compression C has generalized spectrum in (-1,1). Markov-Lukács factorization of a polynomial nonnegative on the exterior central arc, transported via tan((theta-pi)/2), provides f=|P|^2+((c-cos theta)/(1-c))|Q|^2 with degrees N and N-1 without any evenness assumption. The maximal generalized Rayleigh quotient makes the integral strictly positive whenever c>Lambda unless the polynomial is zero; equality at c=Lambda forces P=0, Q in the maximal eigenspace. Nonnegative-support case handled with product of |z-z_j|^2. The one-sided atom pencil yields Lambda=(1/2)*sqrt((1-w)/(1+w)); the symmetrized top eigenvalue is (1-w)/2. Independent exact 2x2 generalized eigenvalue algebra and positivity tests corroborate the formula; finite tests are not offered as the all-degree proof.
